info.title: Remove Restricted Course Restriction API
info.description: API for managing the removal of restricted courses restrictions for providers.

get.summary: Retrieve the removal restriction view for a course

parameters.name: ukprn
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the provider.

parameters.name: larsCode
parameters.description: The LARS code of the restricted course.

200.description: Success view for course removal restriction.

302.description: Redirected to the provider's restricted apprenticeships view if session does not exist.

404.description: Not found if invalid for restriction removal.

post.summary: Remove restriction on a restricted course for a provider

parameters.name: ukprn
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the provider.

parameters.name: larsCode
parameters.description: The LARS code of the restricted course.

302.description: Redirected to the provider's restricted apprenticeships view on success.

404.description: Not found if session does not exist.

UserId.description: The unique identifier of the user making the request.

UserDisplayName.description: The display name of the user making the request.
